svg.title: Sophomores — editable mask and reusable opacity gradient
svg.desc: Approved silhouette and contour gradient at 1.2 falloff and 0.18 core lift. Editable vectors deliberately omit Gaussian smoothing; the runtime PNG/SVG includes 1.39% height smoothing. The separate radial fill is for experiments on other closed shapes, not an exact replacement for contour falloff.

g.text: Falloff 1.2; core lift 0.18. Editable paths; Gaussian smoothing is deliberately not flattened into these vectors.
At a 900px canvas height, apply 12.51px Gaussian smoothing. Runtime PNG/SVG is the exact reference.
Use the Eyedropper on this closed path, or save its gradient as a swatch.
Radial experiment: same opacity curve, not the contour-shaped mask.
Hide the background and labels before exporting transparent PNG. Runtime mask reads ALPHA, not black/white luminance.
